scope_note: This is the AIATSIS Australian scope for Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander research; it is not asserted as a universal legal definition for every Indigenous People. The Code separately applies the definition across research stages and formats.
statement: The AIATSIS Code defines its scope by whether research impacts or is particularly significant to Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples.
statement_zh: AIATSIS Code 以研究是否影響 Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples，或對他們具有特別重要性來界定其範圍。
